note: 16 primary-source verified solid-gold / pure-gold rings spanning 10K, 14K, 18K, and 24K, retrieved directly from official retailer pages on 2026-10-22. 9 of the 16 publish explicit metal gram weights; the remaining 7 keep weight_g_low: null rather than estimating.

rows.title: Italian 10kt Yellow Gold Textured Ring
rows.evidence: Title "Italian 10kt Yellow Gold Textured Ring"; price "$89"; specs "Width 1/16 inch · Metal 10kt Yellow Gold · Gold Weight 0.3 grams · Country of Origin Italy"; FAQ on page "crafted from 10kt yellow gold, meaning it is made of solid gold alloy throughout its structure, not hollow or gold-plated."
rows.notes: Verified 10K benchmark with both explicit "solid gold alloy throughout its structure, not hollow or gold-plated" wording AND published 0.3 grams gold weight. Illustrates why an $89 ring can be genuine solid 10K gold yet hold very small raw-gold mass (0.3 g).
